title: Kickoff time, TV information set for Nebraska-Maryland game
text:
LINCOLN, Neb. (KOLN) - The Big Ten Conference announced the kickoff time and TV information for Nebraska’s Homecoming game against Maryland on Saturday, Oct. 3.

The game will be televised on FS1, with kickoff set for 3 p.m. This will mark Nebraska’s third appearance on FS1 this season.

Nebraska is 3-0 entering this week’s Big Ten opener at Michigan State while Maryland is 2-1 and hosts UCLA this Saturday.

Friday, Oct. 2

7 p.m. - Penn State at Northwestern – FOX (previously announced)

Saturday, Oct.

11 a.m. - Michigan at Minnesota – FOX

11:30 a.m. - Michigan State at Wisconsin – BTN

2:30 p.m. - Ohio State at Iowa – CBS

3 p.m. - Maryland at Nebraska – FS1

3:15 p.m. - Purdue at Illinois – BTN

6:30 p.m. - Washington at USC – NBC

7 p.m. - Indiana at Rutgers – BTN
